description: Check the status of the caller's own pattern-making orders: where each one is, its complexity tier, its fee and when it was placed. Free. Requires authentication. Read-only: it cannot create, pay for or cancel an order.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return (default 10)

order_id.description: A single order id. Omit to list the caller's orders.

status.description: Filter the list by status, e.g. SUBMITTED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED

name: get_order_status
title: Get Order Status
